Hi Camila / Alex — procurement here. A couple of specifics to help you prepare a formal quote: 

- Preferred payment method: PO through Workday (we issue PO, vendor invoices to ap@lumenai.com). Net30 is standard for us unless otherwise negotiated.
- Marketplace: Procurement will accept AWS Marketplace if Redwood is listed and the SKU matches the quoted pricing. Marketplace purchases must be available under our AWS account and support consolidated billing.
- Required vendor information to include on quote: vendor legal name, EIN, billing address, remit-to details, and a point-of-contact for invoicing.
- Contract/terms: we generally accept vendor terms but reserve the right to redline for data/residency clauses; if you have a standard MSA we can start from that.

I attached our PO template for reference (LumenAI_PO_template.docx). Please send the formal quote (line items + term) and vendor info; if you plan to pursue marketplace listing, include the marketplace SKU and whether it’s subscription or metered.
